original_review.key_result: The explicit active carrier floor is characterized for the first route transition: active_chunk_id-only, active_chunk_label-only, both active fields, active plus route_sequence, wrong-next conflicts, and a late active_id retest all advanced from clear_trash to collect_dishes. The next-only no-active negative control refused legal movement instead of inventing active state.
original_review.language_lesson: Explicit active carrier is the minimum legal move_on anchor for the clear_trash starting position. route_sequence alone does not create active state, and next_chunk_id/next_chunk_label alone do not create active state. When an explicit active carrier is present, wrong next_chunk fields do not override the legal clear_trash to collect_dishes movement.

pointer_update.purpose: Test whether the active carrier floor found at clear_trash generalizes across non-start route positions, especially collect_dishes to stack_papers, stack_papers to wipe_surface, and wipe_surface to choose_next, with and without route_sequence.
evidence_reviewed: route_law_active_carrier_floor_001 showed cold active_chunk_id-only advanced from clear_trash to collect_dishes.
route_law_active_carrier_floor_002 showed cold active_chunk_label-only advanced from clear trash to collect_dishes.
route_law_active_carrier_floor_003 showed paired active fields without route_sequence advanced to collect_dishes.
route_law_active_carrier_floor_004 through 006 showed active carrier plus route_sequence advanced to collect_dishes.
route_law_active_carrier_floor_007 showed next_chunk_id/next_chunk_label alone did not establish active state.
route_law_active_carrier_floor_008 through 011 showed wrong next_chunk_id/label stack_papers did not override active carrier and did not cause a skip.
route_law_active_carrier_floor_012 showed a late active_chunk_id-only retest still advanced to collect_dishes.
pointer_update.open_gap: The floor is proven for the first route transition, but not yet for non-start active positions. It is still unknown whether active_chunk_id-only or active_chunk_label-only can carry legal move_on when the active chunk is collect_dishes, stack_papers, or wipe_surface without route_sequence.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Run a focused position-generalization suite using sparse packets and no response_contract or route_law rescue wording. Test active_chunk_id-only, active_chunk_label-only, and both-active fields at collect_dishes, stack_papers, and wipe_surface. Include route_sequence baselines and wrong-next conflicts at non-start positions, plus one no-active negative control.
avoid: do not repeat broad clear_trash-only floor tests except as a single baseline
do not include route_law rescue wording
do not treat first-transition success as proof that the whole route map is carried
do not mix this with language expansion or side-question recovery
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: 15-case focused position-generalization suite: one clear_trash baseline, active_id-only and active_label-only at collect_dishes/stack_papers/wipe_surface, both-active non-start checks, route_sequence baselines, wrong-next conflicts, and one next-only negative control.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire this pointer when active_chunk_id-only, active_chunk_label-only, and both-active packets are clearly classified across non-start route positions and compared against route_sequence baselines and wrong-next conflicts.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate a validator-ready suite for route_law_active_carrier_position_generalization_v1 focused on non-start active carrier movement across the desk-reset-v0 route.
